title: Output of the inventaire-assets agent: the assets to add to the registry before writing the plan sheets

assets.description: The assets the registry does not contain yet and that the plans call for. Empty if the registry is enough. Each asset appears only ONCE, even if it is used in twenty plans.

code.description: Proposed code, prefixed by the type (PROP_lanterne, DEC_phare_nuit). The final code is rebuilt according to the registry's convention.

parent.description: ALWAYS answer. MANDATORY for a state of a recurring subject (character, creature, set or prop: the same set at night, the same character wounded, the same creature emerging): the code of the BASE subject (from the registry, or proposed here), same type as this asset. It is the starting image of the state; the registry is flat, so a state of a state also points to the base subject. `null` only for an independent asset (a distinct prop, a new character, a generic effect). For a `keyframe`, leave empty and list the elements to combine in `raison`.

description.description: (French) What it is, as in the registry: what is seen, with no framing or plan light.

plans.description: The titles of the plans (as given in the input) where the asset appears.

raison.description: (French) Why no registry asset fits: what must really differ in the image.

notes.description: (French) Doubtful matches, registry assets you preferred over a new one, plans that seemed to call for an asset without you creating one. Empty if nothing to say.
